drafts.title: A Gentle Story About Trust and Belonging
drafts.body:
Jordan and the Fosters is an illustrated read-aloud story for children ages 3–8 and the families who read with them.

Jordan is a cautious but gentle dog who struggles to trust and feel that he belongs when he enters the care of the Foster family. With help from Fiona, the family’s wise older dog, Jordan discovers friendship, courage, and the safety of opening his heart. His journey celebrates patience, compassion, trust, belonging, and helping animals.

Share Jordan’s journey of kindness, courage, and belonging with a child you love. Choose your edition of Jordan and the Fosters on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B0D5BT1XDZ
